Quality in process

Controlled at Every Stage

Dimensions and tolerances are checked and recorded continuously during manufacturing, not just at the end. Combined with EDM finishing for the details milling cannot reach, this is how we hold micron-level precision across every mold we deliver.

  • Continuous dimensional control during machining.
  • EDM for intricate geometries and hardened steels.
  • Final inspection of mold and molded parts before delivery.
